instruction.text: Choose which idiom can be used here.

atoms.a: I'm not going to point the finger at her just to make myself look innocent.
atoms.b: I'm not ((++throwing_her_under_the_bus kicking_the_bucket)) just to make myself look innocent.

atoms.a: During the meeting, he accidentally revealed all the details to our friend by mentioning that we had planned a surprise party for him.
atoms.b: During the meeting, he accidentally ((++spilled_the_beans cut_corners)) to our friend by mentioning that we had planned a surprise party for him.

atoms.a: Should I sit in the front, right next to you? That way, I could assist you in case we hit heavy traffic.
atoms.b: Should I ((++ride_shotgun take_a_rain_check))? That way, I could assist you in case we hit heavy traffic.

atoms.a: Please stay patient, someone will take care of you in a second.
atoms.b: Please ((++sit_tight take_this_with_a_grain_of_salt)), someone will take care of you in a second.

atoms.a: Don't blame yourself for needing so much time for your exam prep. Good things take their time.
atoms.b: Don't blame yourself for needing so much time for your exam prep. ((++Rome_wasn't_built_in_a_day It's_a_blessing_in_disguise)).

atoms.a: Sorry, I think I need to reschedule our appointment for today.
atoms.b: Sorry, I think I need to ((++take_a_rain_check get_my_ducks_in_a_row)) for today.

atoms.a: For our group work, it's important that everybody adds value. Otherwise, we'll not make any progress.
atoms.b: For our group work, it's important that everybody ((++brings_something_to_the_table beats_around_the_bush)). Otherwise, we'll not make any progress.

atoms.a: At least my mom and I share the same opinion on that.
atoms.b: At least my mom and I ((++see_eye_to_eye keep_them_it_the_loop)) on that.
